There are several map providers/styles availble.

OSM, Stamen, Esri, CartoDB, Wikimedia are free to use.

Google is conditionally free.
More regarding its business model can be found here.
In order to use Google maps you must provide the Google Maps API Key (if you don't have one yet see the Get API Key page)

Mapbox is conditionally free.
More regarding its business model can be found here.
In order to use Mapbox maps you must provide the Mapbox Access Token (if you don't have one yet register here www.mapbox.com)
All maps styles provided by this service can be found here.

Thunderforest is conditionally free.
More regarding its business model can be found here.
In order to use Thunderforest maps you must provide the Thunderforest Map API Key (if you don't have one yet register here thunderforest.com)
All maps styles provided by this service can be found here.

There are a lot more possible map providers and maps styles. Check this demo for a complete list of possible map providers and styles.
If you're missing some particular map provider/style and would like it to be intergated into the module then contact us and will will add it to the options list with an update.
